segments.en: Because an error against generated TypeScript is an error about code you didn't write. Glyph reports these against your source, with the rule you broke and the edit that fixes it.
segments.tr: 因为针对生成的 TypeScript 报告的错误，说的是你没写过的代码。Glyph 针对你的源码报告这些错误，并附上你违反的规则和修复它的编辑。

segments.en: Glyph compiles to TypeScript and then type-checks the output with tsc --strict, so a mistake Glyph doesn't model isn't lost. It comes back one stage later, phrased in terms of the emitted file: a TS1308 pointing at an await in a function you never spelled, or a TS2366 about a switch you didn't write.
segments.tr: Glyph 编译成 TypeScript，然后用 tsc --strict 对输出做类型检查，所以 Glyph 没有建模的错误不会丢失。它会在下一个阶段出现，用生成文件的说法来表述：一个 TS1308 指向某个你从没写过的函数里的 await，或者一个 TS2366 说的是你没写过的 switch。

segments.en: The line is mapped back to your .glyph, but the explanation isn't. That gap is where the compiler stops teaching.
segments.tr: 行号会映射回你的 .glyph，但解释不会。编译器就是在这个缺口处不再起到教学作用的。

segments.en: So each rule Glyph can decide for itself moves up:
segments.tr: 所以 Glyph 能自行判定的每条规则都被提前了：

segments.en: E0222await outside an async fn
segments.tr: E0222async fn 之外的 await

segments.en: E0223a match arm that produces no value while the match is used as a value
segments.tr: E0223match 被当作值使用时不产生值的 match 分支

segments.en: E0008An assignment written without mut
segments.tr: E0008没有写 mut 的赋值

segments.en: Each names the rule, cites the decision behind it, and shows the before and after.
segments.tr: 每条诊断都会说出规则，引用背后的设计决定，并给出修改前后的对比。

segments.en: An arm that produces no value
segments.tr: 不产生值的分支

segments.en: Before this, the emitted switch fell out of its own cases and text held undefined while its type said string. tsc catches some shapes of that and misses others.
segments.tr: 在此之前，生成的 switch 会从自己的各个 case 中掉出去，text 的值是 undefined，而它的类型写的是 string。tsc 能发现其中一些形态，漏掉另一些。

segments.en: Glyph now decides it wherever the position is decidable: a let, a mut, a return, or the tail of a function that declares a return type. A statement match keeps X => {} as the deliberate no-op it is.
segments.tr: 现在只要位置可判定，Glyph 就会判定：let、mut、return，或者声明了返回类型的函数的末尾表达式。语句形式的 match 仍然把 X => {} 当作有意为之的空操作。

segments.en: await outside an async fn
segments.tr: async fn 之外的 await

segments.en: await is the same move. Glyph has no user-visible Promise: an async fn -> T is awaited to a T, so await anywhere else has nothing to suspend.
segments.tr: await 也是同样的处理。Glyph 没有用户可见的 Promise：async fn -> T 被 await 后得到 T，所以在其他任何地方使用 await 都没有东西可挂起。

segments.en: glyph build, on `fn total() -> number { return await fetch_count() }`
segments.tr: glyph build，针对 `fn total() -> number { return await fetch_count() }`

segments.en: Details which callable decides
segments.tr: 详情 由哪个可调用体决定

segments.en: That used to be tsc's TS1308 on the generated file. It is E0222 now, and the innermost enclosing callable decides, so a synchronous lambda inside an async fn is its own context, the same rule TypeScript uses.
segments.tr: 这以前是生成文件上的 tsc 的 TS1308，现在是 E0222，由最内层的外围可调用体决定，所以 async fn 里的同步 lambda 是它自己的上下文，规则和 TypeScript 相同。

segments.en: An assignment without mut
segments.tr: 没有 mut 的赋值

segments.en: The third one is about a rule people break on day one. Glyph marks every mutation, so reassigning a binding is mut x = e and introducing one is let x = e.
segments.tr: 第三个规则，人们第一天就会违反。Glyph 会标记每一次修改，所以重新赋值一个绑定写作 mut x = e，引入一个绑定写作 let x = e。

segments.en: A bare x = e used to report "unexpected token: Equals", which names a character rather than the rule. It is E0008 now, and glyph --explain E0008 spells out why the mark exists: every place a value changes starts with mut, so grep "mut total" finds all of them.
segments.tr: 单独的 x = e 以前报告的是 "unexpected token: Equals"，说的是一个字符而不是规则。现在它是 E0008，glyph --explain E0008 会说明这个标记为什么存在：值发生变化的每个地方都以 mut 开头，所以 grep "mut total" 能把它们全部找出来。

segments.en: Details the ? operator, E0302 and E0303
segments.tr: 详情 ? 运算符、E0302 和 E0303

segments.en: The ? operator gets the same treatment from the other direction. ? expands to a binding plus an early return placed before the statement it sits in, so it needs a statement to expand into. It works in a let, a return, an argument, and now in a match arm body. Where it can't work, the message says which position it is and how to bind out of it (E0302 and E0303) instead of claiming the operator isn't implemented.
segments.tr: ? 运算符从另一个方向得到了同样的处理。? 会展开为一个绑定加上一个提前 return，放在它所在语句的前面，所以它需要一条可以展开进去的语句。它可以用在 let、return、参数中，现在也可以用在 match 分支体里。在不能使用的地方，报错会说明是哪个位置，以及怎样先绑定出来（E0302 和 E0303），而不是声称这个运算符尚未实现。

segments.en: The worse case: when tsc is happy too
segments.tr: 更糟的情况：tsc 也没报错

segments.en: A tsc error in the wrong place is annoying. A clean build on a program that means something else is the real problem, and Glyph had one.
segments.tr: tsc 的错误报在错误的位置令人烦恼。而一个意思已经变了的程序却构建通过，才是真正的问题，Glyph 就出现过一个。

segments.en: Every top-level name you declare goes into the emitted module verbatim, including a tagged union's variant constructors, so a variant named Error emits export function Error(...) at module top level. The new Error(...) the compiler writes below it then calls your variant.
segments.tr: 你声明的每个顶层名字都会原样进入生成的模块，包括标签联合的变体构造函数，所以一个名为 Error 的变体会在模块顶层生成 export function Error(...)。编译器在它下面写的 new Error(...) 随后调用的就是你的变体。

segments.en: glyph build, on a union with an `Error` variant
segments.tr: glyph build，针对带有 `Error` 变体的联合类型

segments.en: Details type Key = string | number, the guarded list, E0111
segments.tr: 详情 type Key = string | number、受保护的名字列表、E0111

segments.en: type Key = string | number is the same defect with a friendlier face. In Glyph A | B declares a tagged union whose members are variant constructors, so that line declares variants called string and number. It compiled, passed tsc --strict, and emitted an export const number that shadowed the prelude number namespace. Nothing failed until a later number.to_string call did.
segments.tr: type Key = string | number 是同一个缺陷，只是看起来更友好。在 Glyph 中，A | B 声明的是一个标签联合，其成员是变体构造函数，所以这一行声明了名为 string 和 number 的变体。它能编译，能通过 tsc --strict，并生成了一个 export const number，遮蔽了 prelude 中的 number 命名空间。直到后来某次 number.to_string 调用失败之前，什么都没有报错。

segments.en: The span is the declaration, which is where the rename goes. The guarded list is derived from the emitter rather than from a general list of JavaScript globals, and a test greps the emitter and fails when a new global reference appears without a matching entry. That test is the point: Number was harmless until int shipped and started emitting Number.isInteger, which is how this reached a release in the first place. Date, Math, and JSON stay free, because nothing Glyph emits mentions them.
segments.tr: 报错范围是声明本身，也就是需要改名的地方。受保护的名字列表来自代码生成器，而不是一份通用的 JavaScript 全局名字列表，并且有一个测试会 grep 代码生成器，一旦出现新的全局引用却没有对应条目就失败。这个测试才是关键：int 发布并开始生成 Number.isInteger 之前，Number 一直是无害的，这个问题当初就是这样进入了一个版本。Date、Math 和 JSON 仍然可以使用，因为 Glyph 生成的代码从不提到它们。

segments.en: The primitive-union case gets its own code, E0111, because rejecting it without explaining it teaches nothing. It says what the line actually parsed as, points at named variants, and names extern_ts("string | number") for the boundary where you want the raw TypeScript union. Every name Glyph will not let you use is tabulated in docs/reference/reserved-words.md: the 32 keywords, the 33 TypeScript reserved words behind E0109, and the shadow list, each with the reason the name is taken.
segments.tr: 原始类型联合的情况有自己的错误码 E0111，因为只拒绝而不解释，什么也教不会。它会说明这一行实际被解析成了什么，指向具名变体，并给出 extern_ts("string | number")，用于你在边界上需要原始 TypeScript 联合类型的情况。Glyph 不允许你使用的每个名字都列在 docs/reference/reserved-words.md 中：32 个关键字、E0109 背后的 33 个 TypeScript 保留字，以及遮蔽列表，每一项都写明了这个名字被占用的原因。

segments.en: Worth being clear about what this does not do. You still cannot name a type or a variant Error, and the spreadsheet that turned this up ships a variant called Cellerr because of it. The program it wanted to be is still not writable; what changed is that the compiler now says so at the declaration instead of letting the build go green and mean something else.
segments.tr: 需要说清楚这不能做到什么。你仍然不能把类型或变体命名为 Error，发现这个问题的那个电子表格应用也因此把一个变体叫作 Cellerr。它原本想写的程序仍然写不出来；变化在于，编译器现在会在声明处直接指出这一点，而不是让构建通过却表达了别的意思。

segments.en: Details why the name is not simply made usable
segments.tr: 详情 为什么不直接让这个名字可用

segments.en: Making the name usable means mangling Glyph names on the way into TypeScript, which changes what a stack trace, a grep over dist/, and a hand-written extern/ shim see, so it is not a patch we can make quietly.
segments.tr: 要让这个名字可用，就得在进入 TypeScript 时对 Glyph 名字做改写，这会改变堆栈跟踪、对 dist/ 的 grep 以及手写的 extern/ 适配层所看到的内容，所以这不是一个可以悄悄打上的补丁。

segments.en: A wrong message is worse than no message
segments.tr: 错误的报错比没有报错更糟

segments.en: The shadow list started with names the emitter writes as values. It was missing the ones it writes as types, and that produced the sharpest version of this whole problem.
segments.tr: 遮蔽列表最初只包含代码生成器作为值写出的名字，漏掉了它作为类型写出的名字，而这造成了整个问题中最尖锐的一个版本。

segments.en: glyph build, before: fifteen of these, none of them near the cause
segments.tr: glyph build，修改前：十五条这样的报错，没有一条靠近原因

segments.en: glyph build, now
segments.tr: glyph build，现在

segments.en: Details why Issue collides, and Record
segments.tr: 详情 Issue 为什么会冲突，以及 Record

segments.en: Every descriptor's parse returns Result<T, Issue[]>, so the emitted module writes Issue whether or not you did. Declare type Issue = { path: Array<string>, message: string } in your own module and yours wins, the emitted Issue objects carry a code field yours has never heard of, and the build fails with a tsc error about generated code, at a span pointing somewhere else.
segments.tr: 每个描述符的 parse 都返回 Result<T, Issue[]>，所以无论你写没写，生成的模块里都会出现 Issue。如果在你自己的模块里声明 type Issue = { path: Array<string>, message: string }，你的声明就会胜出，生成的 Issue 对象带着一个你的类型从未听说过的 code 字段，构建失败时给出的是一个关于生成代码的 tsc 错误，位置指向别处。

segments.en: Record joined the list at the same time, filed with the JavaScript globals rather than the prelude names because it is a TypeScript built-in and claiming otherwise would make the message wrong about where the name comes from. The drift test that greps the emitter now covers ambient types too, and it had to learn to see Issue[] in a type position, which is the reason this reached a release. Schema, Component and Option stay legal on the same rule that keeps Date free: the emitter writes them only because you wrote them in an annotation, so declaring one shadows nothing.
segments.tr: Record 也在同一时间加入了列表，归在 JavaScript 全局名字下而不是 prelude 名字下，因为它是 TypeScript 内置类型，归错了会让报错在名字来源上说错话。grep 代码生成器的那个偏差测试现在也覆盖了环境类型，而且它必须学会在类型位置上识别 Issue[]，这正是这个问题进入版本的原因。Schema、Component 和 Option 仍然合法，依据的是让 Date 可用的同一条规则：代码生成器只是因为你在注解里写了它们才会写出它们，所以声明其中一个不会遮蔽任何东西。

segments.en: An import that blamed a match
segments.tr: 归咎于 match 的导入

segments.en: The other one in this class was an import. A local import path resolves from the build root, the directory you hand to glyph build, not from the directory of the file doing the importing.
segments.tr: 这一类中的另一个是导入。本地导入路径从构建根目录解析，也就是你交给 glyph build 的那个目录，而不是从发起导入的文件所在目录解析。

segments.en: glyph build examples/apps, on `import catalog` inside csvql/
segments.tr: glyph build examples/apps，针对 csvql/ 中的 `import catalog`

segments.en: Details what it used to report, and how it avoids false positives
segments.tr: 详情 它以前报告什么，以及它如何避免误报

segments.en: Build an enclosing tree and import catalog finds nothing, and until now nothing said so. The type degraded to unknown, a match over it lost the variants it was matching, and what you got was E0218, non-exhaustive match, on a match that covered every case. Doing what that message asked would have added a dead else arm to correct code.
segments.tr: 构建一个外层目录树时，import catalog 什么也找不到，而直到现在都没有任何提示。类型退化成 unknown，对它的 match 丢失了要匹配的变体，你得到的是 E0218（match 不穷尽），而这个 match 其实覆盖了所有情况。照着那条报错去做，会给正确的代码加上一个永远不会执行的 else 分支。

segments.en: The risk in a check like this is that it fires on things that are fine, and an import checker that cries wolf on every npm package is worse than the silence it replaced. So the build first collects the module names it can resolve without a .glyph file: every declare module "X" under <root>/.types/ and in the bundled Node shim, plus every package in the project's node_modules. A name on that list is never reported, even when a local file happens to share its basename. When a project has no node_modules at all, the compiler cannot tell an uninstalled dependency from a typo, so it reports only what it can prove: an import that some .glyph file under the root answers to.
segments.tr: 这类检查的风险在于对没问题的东西也报错，而一个对每个 npm 包都喊“狼来了”的导入检查器，比它取代的沉默还要糟。所以构建会先收集不需要 .glyph 文件就能解析的模块名：<root>/.types/ 下和内置 Node 适配层中的每个 declare module "X"，以及项目 node_modules 中的每个包。这个列表上的名字永远不会被报告，即使某个本地文件恰好和它同名。如果项目根本没有 node_modules，编译器无法区分未安装的依赖和拼写错误，所以只报告它能证明的情况：根目录下确实有某个 .glyph 文件与之对应的导入。

segments.en: Resolution itself did not change. The same programs build and the same programs fail. What changed is that the failure now names the import instead of accusing a match two files away, which is the whole of it: a compiler that reports the wrong cause costs you the hour spent chasing it, and then the benefit of the doubt on every message after.
segments.tr: 解析本身没有变化。能构建的程序还是那些，失败的程序也还是那些。变化在于失败时报错会指出导入，而不是去指责两个文件之外的一个 match，全部改动就是这些：一个报错原因说错的编译器，会让你花一个小时去追查，之后的每条报错你也不会再轻易相信。

segments.en: Naming the rule, not the token
segments.tr: 说出规则，而不是记号

segments.en: The quieter version of the same problem is an error that is correct and still tells you nothing.
segments.tr: 同一个问题更隐蔽的版本，是一个正确却什么也没告诉你的错误。

segments.en: glyph check, before and now
segments.tr: glyph check，修改前与现在

segments.en: Details the red-black tree, and how the fix names your program
segments.tr: 详情 红黑树，以及修复方法如何用上你的程序

segments.en: An agent writing a red-black tree reached for the positional constructor every ML-family language has, and the parser stopped on its first comma with “expected )” and the advice “add the expected token”. Adding a ) there produces a different program, not a working one. A Glyph variant carries one payload, and a payload with several fields is a record. Neither of those sentences was anywhere in the output.
segments.tr: 一个编写红黑树的智能体使用了每个 ML 系语言都有的位置参数构造函数，解析器在第一个逗号处停下，报出 “expected )”，并建议 “add the expected token”。在那里加一个 ) 只会得到另一个程序，而不是一个能工作的程序。Glyph 的变体只携带一个负载，含有多个字段的负载是一个记录。这两句话在输出中都找不到。

segments.en: To say that, the parser had to read the whole list before refusing it, which is also what lets it count. The span underlines all six fields rather than the separator it happened to die on, and the suggested record is built from the variant name and the six types in the file, so the fix names your program rather than an example of someone else’s. Field names are the one thing the compiler cannot supply, so it leaves them as holes.
segments.tr: 为了说出这些，解析器必须先读完整个列表再拒绝它，这也让它能够计数。报错范围标出全部六个字段，而不是它恰好停下的那个分隔符；建议的记录是根据变体名和文件中的六个类型构造的，所以修复方法用的是你的程序，而不是别人的示例。字段名是编译器唯一无法提供的东西，所以它把这些留作空位。

segments.en: The rule behind the message is a choice, not a gap. Node(Black, l, x, b, h, r) is the argument swap that type-checks, and position four tells a reader nothing. The record spelling names every field, a match arm names only the fields it uses, and both of those are things grep can find.
segments.tr: 这条报错背后的规则是一个选择，而不是缺口。Node(Black, l, x, b, h, r) 是那种参数调换后照样能通过类型检查的写法，第四个位置对读者来说什么也没说明。记录写法给每个字段命名，match 分支只命名它用到的字段，这两者都是 grep 能找到的。

segments.en: Two more the checker took over in 0.1.121
segments.tr: 0.1.121 中检查器接手的另外两项

segments.en: Order { id: "a", total: 1 } is what someone coming from TypeScript writes to build a record, and Glyph has no such form: a value is written on its own and the type goes on the annotation.
segments.tr: Order { id: "a", total: 1 } 是从 TypeScript 过来的人构造记录时会写的，而 Glyph 没有这种形式：值单独书写，类型写在注解上。

segments.en: glyph check, on a record built the TypeScript way
segments.tr: glyph check，针对按 TypeScript 方式构造的记录

segments.en: since 0.1.146
History from E0108 to E0228 to E0013
segments.tr: 历史 从 E0108 到 E0228 再到 E0013

segments.en: What the compiler used to say about that line was E0108, unreachable code, on a build that exited 0, because the name resolved to the type and the braces parsed as a block after the return. A type's name written as a value is E0228, and the message is read off the declaration, so a record lists its fields, a tagged union lists its variants with their payload shapes, and a string-literal union lists its literals. Order.parse(raw) and Order.is(v) stay legal, since the receiver of a type's own descriptor is the one expression position a type name belongs in.
segments.tr: 编译器以前对这一行报告的是 E0108（不可达代码），而构建退出码为 0，因为这个名字解析成了类型，花括号被解析成 return 之后的一个代码块。把类型名当作值来写现在是 E0228，报错内容从声明中读取，所以记录会列出它的字段，标签联合会列出它的变体及负载形态，字符串字面量联合会列出它的字面量。Order.parse(raw) 和 Order.is(v) 仍然合法，因为类型自身描述符的接收者，是类型名唯一应该出现的表达式位置。

segments.en: That fixed the case where the name was a type and left the parse alone, so return h() { k: 2 } still returned h() and dropped the braces with a warning. Since 0.1.146 a { on the line where a statement ended is E0013 at parse, whatever the name before it is, and its help gives the same rewrite. Since 0.1.149 the rule covers every statement, not only one opening with a brace: let s = "a" "b" used to bind "a" and drop "b", and return x as User was three statements, since Glyph has no cast.
segments.tr: 这修复了名字是类型的情况，但没有改变解析，所以 return h() { k: 2 } 仍然返回 h()，并带着一条警告丢掉花括号。从 0.1.146 起，在一条语句结束的那一行上出现的 { 在解析阶段就是 E0013，无论它前面的名字是什么，帮助信息给出同样的改写。从 0.1.149 起，这条规则覆盖所有语句，而不只是以花括号开头的语句：let s = "a" "b" 以前会绑定 "a" 并丢掉 "b"，return x as User 则是三条语句，因为 Glyph 没有类型断言。

segments.en: Each statement in a block starts its own line.
segments.tr: 代码块中的每条语句都要另起一行。

segments.en: A container where a primitive is declared
segments.tr: 在声明为原始类型的地方出现容器

segments.en: The other one is a prelude container assigned to a primitive. let x: string = o where o: Option<int> drew nothing from the Glyph checker, and neither did passing a Nullable<int> to a parameter declared int.
segments.tr: 另一项是把 prelude 容器赋给原始类型。o: Option<int> 时，let x: string = o 在 Glyph 检查器那里没有任何报错，把 Nullable<int> 传给声明为 int 的参数也没有。

segments.en: Five containers are covered in both directions now: Option, Result, Array, Record and Nullable are never a string, a number or a bool, whatever their arguments, and Nullable<T> against a scalar is decided one level in against T, so let v: Nullable<int> = 3 stays correct and let v: Nullable<int> = "three" is E0204.
segments.tr: 现在五种容器在两个方向上都有覆盖：Option、Result、Array、Record 和 Nullable 无论类型参数是什么，都绝不是 string、number 或 bool；Nullable<T> 与标量比较时会深入一层，针对 T 判定，所以 let v: Nullable<int> = 3 仍然正确，而 let v: Nullable<int> = "three" 是 E0204。

segments.en: Details the case only Glyph can catch, and records since 0.1.130
segments.tr: 详情 只有 Glyph 能发现的情况，以及自 0.1.130 起的记录

segments.en: The Nullable case belongs on this page more than the others, because it is one tsc cannot make: the emitted const v: number | null = 3 narrows back to number before the call is checked, so a boundary type that exists to make null visible was passing silently where an int was declared, and the Glyph checker was the only place it could have been caught.
segments.tr: Nullable 这种情况比其他几种更应该放在这一页，因为它是 tsc 无法判定的：生成的 const v: number | null = 3 在检查调用之前就收窄回了 number，所以一个本来为了让 null 可见而存在的边界类型，在声明为 int 的地方悄无声息地通过了，而 Glyph 检查器是唯一能发现它的地方。

segments.en: The same containers against a declared record or union came next. Since 0.1.130 let user: User = json.parse(body) is E0204, expected User, found Result<unknown, Array<Issue>>. Before, only tsc said so, which meant glyph check --no-tsc, the editor and the playground showed a clean file on the one line a boundary exists to get right.
segments.tr: 接下来是同样这些容器与声明的记录或联合类型的比较。从 0.1.130 起，let user: User = json.parse(body) 是 E0204，期望 User，实际是 Result<unknown, Array<Issue>>。以前只有 tsc 会指出这一点，也就是说 glyph check --no-tsc、编辑器和 playground 在边界最需要写对的那一行上显示的是一个干净的文件。

segments.en: A misspelled member on an array or a string
segments.tr: 数组或字符串上拼错的成员名

segments.en: A misspelled member on an array or a string is the other case that used to wait for tsc. xs.lenght is E0210 with "did you mean length", checked against the members TypeScript's library declares for arrays and strings, the way a record's field read is checked against its fields.
segments.tr: 数组或字符串上拼错的成员名，是另一种以前要等 tsc 才发现的情况。xs.lenght 是 E0210，并提示 "did you mean length"，检查依据是 TypeScript 库为数组和字符串声明的成员，就像读取记录字段时依据它的字段来检查一样。

segments.en: tsc would have refused both, so a build that ran it was already red; the change is that the checker, and everything built on it, sees them first.
segments.tr: tsc 本来也会拒绝这两种情况，所以运行它的构建本来就已经失败；变化在于检查器以及构建在它之上的一切会先看到它们。

segments.en: And three more, since 0.1.133
segments.tr: 从 0.1.133 起，还有三项

segments.en: A method read off its string
segments.tr: 从字符串上取下的方法

segments.en: let up = s.toUpperCase type-checks in TypeScript and throws when up() runs, because the read drops the string it belongs to. Glyph refuses it as E0234, and refuses .bind(s) on it too: wrap the call in a lambda instead.
segments.tr: let up = s.toUpperCase 在 TypeScript 中能通过类型检查，但运行 up() 时会抛出异常，因为这次读取丢掉了方法所属的字符串。Glyph 以 E0234 拒绝它，也拒绝对它调用 .bind(s)：改为把调用包在一个 lambda 里。

segments.en: Details where the method types come from
segments.tr: 详情 方法的类型从哪里来

segments.en: The checker now knows what each array and string method returns, from a table generated out of TypeScript's own declarations.
segments.tr: 检查器现在知道每个数组和字符串方法的返回类型，依据是一张从 TypeScript 自身声明生成的表。

segments.en: Optional chaining on a Result
segments.tr: Result 上的可选链

segments.en: r?.label on a Result reads like "propagate the error, then read the field". It is optional chaining, and a Result is never null, so it reads the field off the Result object and propagates nothing.
segments.tr: Result 上的 r?.label 读起来像是“传播错误，然后读取字段”。实际上它是可选链，而 Result 永远不是 null，所以它从 Result 对象上读取字段，什么也没有传播。

segments.en: An agent wrote exactly that while building a CSV query tool. It is E0236 now, on an Option as well, and the help says to bind with ? first.
segments.tr: 一个智能体在构建 CSV 查询工具时就写了这样的代码。现在它是 E0236，对 Option 也一样，帮助信息会提示先用 ? 绑定。

segments.en: An unchecked json.parse
segments.tr: 未经检查的 json.parse

segments.en: json.parse(body) with no type argument is the unchecked read, a Result<unknown, ...>. Written where a Result<User, ...> was declared, tsc used to infer User from the declaration and the program crashed on its first field read.
segments.tr: 不带类型参数的 json.parse(body) 是未经检查的读取，得到 Result<unknown, ...>。把它写在声明为 Result<User, ...> 的地方时，tsc 以前会根据声明推断出 User，程序在第一次读取字段时崩溃。

segments.en: The emitter now writes the unknown out, so glyph check refuses it through tsc.
segments.tr: 代码生成器现在会把 unknown 写出来，所以 glyph check 会通过 tsc 拒绝它。

segments.en: Glyph's own checker does not yet catch an unknown landing inside a declared type, so --no-tsc and the editor still miss Result<unknown, ...> written where Result<User, ...> is declared. (A bare let user: User = json.parse(body) is E0204 from Glyph's own checker, because the outer type is already wrong.) Refusing unknown at every depth is planned as G325, on the release roadmap.
segments.tr: Glyph 自己的检查器还发现不了出现在声明类型内部的 unknown，所以 --no-tsc 和编辑器仍然会漏掉写在声明为 Result<User, ...> 处的 Result<unknown, ...>。（单独的 let user: User = json.parse(body) 由 Glyph 自己的检查器报告为 E0204，因为外层类型已经不对了。）在任意深度拒绝 unknown 已作为 G325 列入发布路线图。

segments.en: And two more in 0.1.122
segments.tr: 0.1.122 中还有两项

segments.en: type Mode = "read" | "write" declares a finite set of strings, and the Glyph checker compared a value against it by nothing at all. A number, a bool, a record and a string outside the set all passed glyph check --no-tsc with nothing but unused-variable warnings, while tsc refused every one of them on the emitted TypeScript.
segments.tr: type Mode = "read" | "write" 声明了一个有限的字符串集合，而 Glyph 检查器在把值与它比较时根本没有做任何比较。数字、bool、记录以及集合之外的字符串，都能通过 glyph check --no-tsc，只有未使用变量的警告，而 tsc 在生成的 TypeScript 上会拒绝其中每一个。

segments.en: So a full glyph build was never wrong about this, but the four surfaces that have no tsc in the loop were: --no-tsc, the language server, the MCP tools and the playground.
segments.tr: 所以完整的 glyph build 在这一点上从未出错，但不经过 tsc 的四个地方会出错：--no-tsc、语言服务器、MCP 工具和 playground。

segments.en: glyph check --no-tsc, on a type that lists its legal strings
segments.tr: glyph check --no-tsc，针对一个列出其合法字符串的类型

segments.en: Details how the union is compared
segments.tr: 详情 联合类型如何比较

segments.en: That is the four tsc reported, at the same four statements, without running tsc. The rule reads the union as what it is at run time, a string, and asks the checker the corresponding string question in each direction, so it inherits the rules that already refuse a record or a container against a string rather than restating them one shape at a time. Two literal sets are compared by set, so a narrower union goes where a wider one is declared; an alias chain is followed on both sides; an imported union is decided like a local one; and Nullable<Mode> is descended with the union intact.
segments.tr: 这就是 tsc 报告的那四条，在相同的四条语句上，而且不需要运行 tsc。这条规则把联合类型按它在运行时的本来面目看待，也就是一个 string，并在每个方向上向检查器提出相应的 string 问题，所以它继承了已有的、拒绝把记录或容器当作 string 的规则，而不是逐个形态重新陈述一遍。两个字面量集合按集合比较，所以更窄的联合类型可以放在声明为更宽联合类型的地方；别名链在两侧都会被追踪；导入的联合类型和本地的一样判定；Nullable<Mode> 会被展开，联合类型保持不变。

segments.en: A union nested in a record field or a generic argument was left to tsc in 0.1.122 and is decided in 0.1.123. See below.
segments.tr: 嵌套在记录字段或泛型参数中的联合类型，在 0.1.122 中留给了 tsc，在 0.1.123 中由 Glyph 判定。见下文。

segments.en: 0.1.123: the literal a value is, not the string it emits to
segments.tr: 0.1.123：值本身是哪个字面量，而不是它生成后的 string

segments.en: type Mode = "read" | "write" put the set on the declaration and nothing on the value, so "read" was a string and ["read", "write"] an Array<string>.
segments.tr: type Mode = "read" | "write" 把集合放在声明上，而值上什么也没有，所以 "read" 是 string，["read", "write"] 是 Array<string>。

segments.en: History what 0.1.122 gave up
segments.tr: 历史 0.1.122 放弃了什么

segments.en: That made two programs indistinguishable: return ["read", "write"] where an Array<Mode> is declared, which tsc compiles, and return xs for an xs: Array<string>, which it refuses. 0.1.122 declined the pairing rather than get it wrong, and that bought the right program by giving up the wrong one: { mode: "nope" } against a { mode: Mode } drew nothing.
segments.tr: 这让两个程序无法区分：在声明为 Array<Mode> 的地方 return ["read", "write"]，tsc 能编译通过；而对 xs: Array<string> 写 return xs，它会拒绝。0.1.122 选择不判定这种配对，而不是判错，这样保住了正确的程序，代价是放过了错误的程序：{ mode: "nope" } 对照 { mode: Mode } 不会有任何报错。

segments.en: A written string literal now has the one-literal type it spells, an array literal's element type is the join of its elements', and a written array or object literal is checked element by element and field by field against the declared type, so the diagnostic names the literal and underlines it.
segments.tr: 现在写出的字符串字面量具有它所写的那个单一字面量类型，数组字面量的元素类型是其各元素类型的并，写出的数组或对象字面量会针对声明的类型逐个元素、逐个字段地检查，所以诊断会指出那个字面量并给它加上下划线。

segments.en: glyph check --no-tsc, on a literal one container in
segments.tr: glyph check --no-tsc，针对容器内一层的字面量

segments.en: Details where the literal widens, and Record keys since 0.1.153
segments.tr: 详情 字面量在哪里放宽，以及自 0.1.153 起的 Record 键

segments.en: The literal widens back to string where TypeScript widens it: at a let with no annotation, whose emitted TypeScript let widens the same way, and at the element binding of a for over a written array. So let l = "read" followed by takes_mode(l) is refused here and TS2345 there. A const emits a TypeScript const and keeps its literal, so takes_mode(CM) compiles under both. A literal type that arrived through a name is not widened, which is TypeScript's own freshness rule. Every row of that was settled by running tsc --strict on the equivalent TypeScript rather than reasoned about.
segments.tr: 字面量在 TypeScript 放宽它的地方也会放宽回 string：在没有注解的 let 处，它生成的 TypeScript let 也以同样的方式放宽；以及在遍历写出的数组的 for 的元素绑定处。所以 let l = "read" 之后接 takes_mode(l) 在这里被拒绝，在那边是 TS2345。const 生成 TypeScript 的 const，保留其字面量，所以 takes_mode(CM) 在两边都能编译。通过名字传来的字面量类型不会被放宽，这是 TypeScript 自己的新鲜度规则。上面的每一条都是通过对等价的 TypeScript 运行 tsc --strict 确定的，而不是推理出来的。

segments.en: The key argument of a Record is held more strictly than tsc holds it, since 0.1.153. TypeScript writes Record<string, V> as an index signature and accepts it against a Record<Mode, V> in both directions. Glyph refuses both: the open map may hold keys outside Mode or miss one, and a Record<Mode, V> passed on as the open one can be written a stray key. Going from one to the other is an is arm or a json.parse.
segments.tr: 从 0.1.153 起，Record 的键类型参数受到比 tsc 更严格的检查。TypeScript 把 Record<string, V> 写成一个索引签名，并在两个方向上都接受它与 Record<Mode, V> 互换。Glyph 两个方向都拒绝：开放的映射可能含有 Mode 之外的键，也可能缺少某个键；而被当作开放映射传出去的 Record<Mode, V> 可能被写入一个多余的键。要从一种转换到另一种，用一个 is 分支或 json.parse。

segments.en: Two shapes the checker still says nothing about: a literal inside Some(...), because a prelude constructor has no type here yet, and a record literal bound to an unannotated let, because no record type is synthesized for an object literal.
segments.tr: 检查器还有两种形态什么也不说：Some(...) 里的字面量，因为 prelude 构造函数在这里还没有类型；以及绑定到无注解 let 的记录字面量，因为不会为对象字面量合成记录类型。

segments.en: A module under std/ was dead code with no diagnostic
segments.tr: std/ 下的模块成了没有诊断的死代码

segments.en: std/ and extern/ name modules the compiler carries, and the resolver reserved them for imports. Nothing stopped a project file from declaring one.
segments.tr: std/ 和 extern/ 指的是编译器自带的模块，解析器为导入保留了它们。但没有任何东西阻止项目文件声明这样一个模块。

segments.en: glyph check --no-tsc, on src/io.glyph declaring `module std/io`
segments.tr: glyph check --no-tsc，针对声明了 `module std/io` 的 src/io.glyph

segments.en: Details what used to happen, and which paths are reserved
segments.tr: 详情 以前会发生什么，以及哪些路径被保留

segments.en: module std/io in your own src/io.glyph compiled clean, and then import std/io { shout } resolved to the stub and reported that shout is not exported: your file was never read.
segments.tr: 在你自己的 src/io.glyph 中写 module std/io 能干净地编译，然后 import std/io { shout } 解析到了内置的存根，并报告 shout 没有被导出：你的文件从来没被读取。

segments.en: The prefix is matched as a whole first segment, so standard, externals/io, app/std and app/extern/helper are untouched, and importing under either prefix still works the way it always did.
segments.tr: 前缀按完整的第一段匹配，所以 standard、externals/io、app/std 和 app/extern/helper 不受影响，在这两个前缀下的导入也和以前一样工作。

segments.en: A file that draws no diagnostic and runs no code is the worst shape a compiler can leave you in, because nothing about it looks wrong.
segments.tr: 一个不产生任何诊断、也不运行任何代码的文件，是编译器能留给你的最糟的局面，因为它看起来没有任何问题。

segments.en: The second one in 0.1.122
segments.tr: 0.1.122 中的第二项

segments.en: A parser depth limit
segments.tr: 解析器深度上限

segments.en: The second one is not a tsc story at all. The parser is recursive descent with no depth guard, so an expression nested two thousand levels deep ran the process out of stack and aborted with exit 134.
segments.tr: 第二项与 tsc 完全无关。解析器是递归下降的，没有深度保护，所以嵌套两千层的表达式会耗尽进程的栈，以退出码 134 中止。

segments.en: glyph check, on `const x = ` followed by 2,000 nested brackets
segments.tr: glyph check，针对 `const x = ` 后跟 2,000 层嵌套括号

segments.en: Details why it mattered for the language server
segments.tr: 详情 为什么这对语言服务器很重要

segments.en: That is bad on glyph check and worse on glyph lsp and glyph mcp, which read every file under the root: one pathological file took the server down for the whole workspace. It is E0011 now, raised at the token that would have opened level 65.
segments.tr: 这在 glyph check 上很糟，在 glyph lsp 和 glyph mcp 上更糟，因为它们会读取根目录下的每个文件：一个病态文件就能让整个工作区的服务器崩溃。现在它是 E0011，在本会打开第 65 层的那个记号处报告。

segments.en: The limit is 64 and it was measured rather than picked.
segments.tr: 上限是 64，这个数字是测量出来的，而不是随便选的。

segments.en: Details how 64 was measured
segments.tr: 详情 64 是怎么测出来的

segments.en: One level of the costliest construct, a nested array literal, costs 7,792 bytes of stack in the release build and 8,810 in the debug one, found by binary-searching the smallest thread stack a given depth will parse in. The thinnest stack the parser runs on is a spawned thread's 2 MiB, which is what the language server's workers get, and 64 levels spend under a third of it in the costlier build. The deepest nesting across the 343 .glyph files in this repository is 16. The limit covers expressions, types, patterns, blocks and JSX children alike, and a thousand sibling arrays still parse, because depth is per-construct nesting and not a budget spent over the file.
segments.tr: 最耗栈的构造是嵌套数组字面量，每一层在 release 构建中消耗 7,792 字节栈空间，在 debug 构建中消耗 8,810 字节，这是通过二分查找给定深度能够解析所需的最小线程栈得出的。解析器运行时最小的栈是新建线程的 2 MiB，也就是语言服务器工作线程得到的大小，64 层在更耗栈的构建中用掉的不到其三分之一。本仓库 343 个 .glyph 文件中最深的嵌套是 16 层。这个上限同样适用于表达式、类型、模式、代码块和 JSX 子节点，一千个并列的数组仍然可以解析，因为深度指的是单个构造的嵌套层数，而不是整个文件共用的额度。

segments.en: When neither compiler is wrong
segments.tr: 当两个编译器都没错时

segments.en: There is a third shape, and it is the one that reads worst. Glyph reports nothing, tsc reports something true, and the program you wrote was fine.
segments.tr: 还有第三种形态，读起来最糟。Glyph 什么也不报，tsc 报告的内容是真的，而你写的程序没有问题。

segments.en: What failed is the translation between them.
segments.tr: 出错的是两者之间的翻译。

segments.en: poll.glyph, and what tsc said about it before 0.1.89
segments.tr: poll.glyph，以及 0.1.89 之前 tsc 对它的报错

segments.en: Details why tsc saw false, and the app that hit it
segments.tr: 详情 tsc 为什么看到的是 false，以及遇到这个问题的应用

segments.en: A binding in Glyph has one type for the whole of its life. TypeScript narrows a binding to whatever it last saw assigned, and its boolean is the union true | false, so let done = false reached tsc typed false and the true arm of the emitted switch had nothing to match.
segments.tr: 在 Glyph 中，一个绑定在整个生命周期内只有一种类型。TypeScript 会把绑定收窄成它最后看到的赋值，它的 boolean 是联合类型 true | false，所以 let done = false 到达 tsc 时类型是 false，生成的 switch 中 true 那个分支就没有东西可匹配了。

segments.en: A type declared as a set of string literals failed the same way, and so did ==, which came back as TS2367 instead: two messages, two codes, one cause. The app that hit it was polling a flag a timer callback sets, which is how you turn an event-based API into a value while Glyph has no Promise you can construct by hand. The callback turned out to be beside the point: four lines with no callback do it.
segments.tr: 声明为字符串字面量集合的类型也以同样的方式失败，== 也是，只是报的是 TS2367：两条报错，两个错误码，一个原因。遇到这个问题的应用在轮询一个由定时器回调设置的标志，在 Glyph 没有可手动构造的 Promise 的情况下，这就是把基于事件的 API 变成一个值的做法。后来发现回调与此无关：四行没有回调的代码就能复现。

segments.en: The fix is not a new diagnostic, because there is nothing to diagnose. The emitter now restates the type the checker already decided, at the two places that discriminate over a value: the match scrutinee and either side of a == or !=.
segments.tr: 修复不是一条新诊断，因为没有什么可诊断的。代码生成器现在会在对值做区分的两个地方，重新写出检查器已经判定的类型：match 的被匹配值，以及 == 或 != 的两侧。

segments.en: Details the checks that still fire, and what it costs
segments.tr: 详情 仍会触发的检查，以及代价

segments.en: Each side is decided by its own type and ignores what sits next to it, so a comparison between two bindings is covered the same way a comparison against a literal is.
segments.tr: 每一侧都由它自己的类型决定，不管旁边是什么，所以两个绑定之间的比较和与字面量的比较一样被覆盖。

segments.en: The checks you want still fire. m == "nope" where m is a Mode is still rejected, and now the message names Mode instead of the single member m happened to be holding. Doing this at the assignment instead would have been less code and would have thrown that away: a cast to Mode is accepted where the annotated assignment is not, and the membership check is the part Glyph leaves to tsc on purpose.
segments.tr: 你需要的检查仍然会触发。m 是 Mode 时，m == "nope" 仍然会被拒绝，而且现在报错指出的是 Mode，而不是 m 碰巧持有的那个单一成员。在赋值处做这件事代码会更少，但会把这一点丢掉：在带注解的赋值不被接受的地方，转换到 Mode 的类型断言会被接受，而成员检查正是 Glyph 有意留给 tsc 的部分。

segments.en: What it costs is small and worth naming. A cast can narrow as well as confirm, so a value Glyph types as bool whose TypeScript type came out unknown now passes where the switch used to complain. The two types still have to be comparable, so a model that has drifted far enough to matter, string against bool, reports TS2352 rather than nothing.
segments.tr: 代价很小，但值得说明。类型断言既能确认类型，也能收窄类型，所以一个 Glyph 定为 bool、而 TypeScript 类型最终是 unknown 的值，现在能在 switch 以前报错的地方通过。两个类型仍然必须可比较，所以如果模型偏差大到真正有影响，比如 string 对 bool，就会报告 TS2352，而不是什么也不报。

segments.en: The same typo, two answers
segments.tr: 同一个拼写错误，两种答案

segments.en: A misspelled standard-library function used to get a different answer depending on how you had written the import, which is the kind of inconsistency that teaches you not to trust either answer.
segments.tr: 拼错的标准库函数名，以前会因为导入写法不同而得到不同的答案，这种不一致会让你两个答案都不再信任。

segments.en: the named import, always an E0105
segments.tr: 具名导入，一直是 E0105

segments.en: the namespace read, before 0.1.72
segments.tr: 命名空间读取，0.1.72 之前

segments.en: Both spellings go through the export list now, and both say E0105, naming the member and the module it is missing from.
segments.tr: 现在两种写法都会经过导出列表，都会报告 E0105，指出缺少的成员及其所在模块。

segments.en: Details why the two spellings differed, and what switching it on found
segments.tr: 详情 两种写法为什么不同，以及启用后发现了什么

segments.en: The first spelling was checked against the module's export list during resolution. The second was not checked at all, so it fell through to tsc, which saw a property access on an object and answered in those terms.
segments.tr: 第一种写法在解析阶段会对照模块的导出列表检查。第二种写法根本没有检查，所以落到了 tsc 那里，它看到的是对一个对象的属性访问，并以此作答。

segments.en: Switching it on immediately found something nobody was looking for: a test fixture had been calling fs.write, where the function is write_text. It had passed for months because that fixture runs with type-checking off, and nothing else in the compiler looked at namespace members. The export list is now the authority for both spellings, so a separate check keeps it in step with what the runtime actually exports. That check was written, then deliberately broken to confirm it failed, which is how we found its first version had been silently checking nothing.
segments.tr: 这项检查一启用，就发现了一个没人在找的问题：一个测试夹具一直在调用 fs.write，而函数名其实是 write_text。它通过了好几个月，因为那个夹具在关闭类型检查的情况下运行，而编译器中没有其他地方会查看命名空间成员。导出列表现在是两种写法的唯一依据，所以另有一项检查让它与运行时实际导出的内容保持一致。那项检查写好之后，又被故意弄坏以确认它会失败，我们正是这样发现它的第一版一直在悄无声息地什么也没检查。

segments.en: Getting sharper
segments.tr: 正在改进

segments.en: array.map, flat_map and zip still take an async callback without complaint
segments.tr: array.map、flat_map 和 zip 仍然会毫无异议地接受 async 回调

segments.en: Details
segments.tr: 详情

segments.en: array.map, flat_map and zip still take an async callback without complaint and hand back an array of pending values, which prints as [object Promise]; the five predicate-taking array functions do stop it, with E0211 at the callback. Modeling the other three the same way also rejects par.all(array.map(items, async fn ...)), which is how Glyph runs work concurrently, because an array of pending values has no spelling in the language. That is a type-system decision rather than a missing entry, so it is open.
segments.tr: array.map、flat_map 和 zip 仍然会毫无异议地接受 async 回调，并返回一个由待定值组成的数组，打印出来是 [object Promise]；五个接受谓词的数组函数确实会阻止这种情况，在回调处报告 E0211。用同样方式为另外三个建模，也会拒绝 par.all(array.map(items, async fn ...))，而这正是 Glyph 并发执行任务的方式，因为由待定值组成的数组在语言中没有写法。这是一个类型系统层面的决定，而不是少了一个条目，所以它仍是开放问题。

segments.en: A top-level await is allowed
segments.tr: 允许顶层 await

segments.en: A module-level const initializer has no enclosing callable, so a top-level await is allowed and the emitted ESM runs it; whether Glyph wants implicit async module init is still an open spec question.
segments.tr: 模块级 const 初始化表达式没有外围可调用体，所以顶层 await 是允许的，生成的 ESM 会执行它；Glyph 是否需要隐式的异步模块初始化，仍是一个开放的规范问题。

segments.en: E0223 can only judge a tail match when the function declares a return type, so an arm inside an unannotated lambda still reaches tsc.
segments.tr: E0223 只有在函数声明了返回类型时才能判断末尾的 match，所以无注解 lambda 内的分支仍然会落到 tsc。

segments.en: E0110 tells you to rename rather than letting you keep the name
segments.tr: E0110 让你改名，而不是让你保留这个名字

segments.en: On the shadow side, two things are only half done. E0110 tells you to rename rather than letting you keep the name, so Error, Number, Object, Array and Promise are still off limits for a type or a variant.
segments.tr: 在遮蔽这一边，有两件事只做了一半。E0110 让你改名，而不是让你保留这个名字，所以 Error、Number、Object、Array 和 Promise 仍然不能用作类型或变体名。

segments.en: E0111 stops type Key = string | number from meaning the wrong thing without giving you a way to say it
segments.tr: E0111 阻止了 type Key = string | number 表达错误的意思，却没有给你正确表达的方法

segments.en: And E0111 stops type Key = string | number from meaning the wrong thing without giving you a way to say it: a union of two primitive types has no spelling in Glyph except extern_ts, whose contents its own checker treats as opaque. Untagged unions touch exhaustiveness, runtime descriptors and is, so that one is a type-system decision and it is not scheduled.
segments.tr: E0111 阻止了 type Key = string | number 表达错误的意思，却没有给你正确表达的方法：两个原始类型的联合在 Glyph 中除了 extern_ts 之外没有写法，而它的内容对 Glyph 自己的检查器是不透明的。非标签联合涉及穷尽性、运行时描述符和 is，所以这是一个类型系统层面的决定，尚未排期。

segments.en: E0104 reaches glyph build and glyph check but not the editor
segments.tr: E0104 会出现在 glyph build 和 glyph check 中，但不会出现在编辑器中

segments.en: E0104 reaches glyph build and glyph check but not the editor: the LSP analyzes a document's text with no build root, and the workspace folder is not one either, so guessing would produce the false positives the check was designed to avoid.
segments.tr: E0104 会出现在 glyph build 和 glyph check 中，但不会出现在编辑器中：LSP 分析文档文本时没有构建根目录，工作区文件夹也不是构建根目录，靠猜测只会产生这项检查本来要避免的误报。

segments.en: A reserved-word parameter still hides behind an unrelated error in the same file, because a failure in the collect pass skips the resolve pass that would have found it.
segments.tr: 保留字参数仍然会被同一文件中一个无关的错误掩盖，因为收集阶段的失败会跳过本可以发现它的解析阶段。

segments.en: The read-site pin follows a type alias only inside the module being emitted
segments.tr: 读取点类型固定只在正在生成的模块内部追踪类型别名

segments.en: Separately, the read-site pin that keeps a bool or string-literal-union binding matchable follows a type alias only inside the module being emitted, so pub type Ready = bool in one module and let r: catalog.Ready = false in another still reaches tsc as TS2678. String-literal unions are covered across modules in all three import spellings, and since 0.1.123 the diagnostic names the declaration (expected Mode) under every spelling instead of printing its literal set under one of them.
segments.tr: 此外，让 bool 或字符串字面量联合绑定保持可匹配的读取点类型固定，只在正在生成的模块内部追踪类型别名，所以一个模块中的 pub type Ready = bool 加上另一个模块中的 let r: catalog.Ready = false，仍然会以 TS2678 落到 tsc。字符串字面量联合在三种导入写法下都能跨模块覆盖，并且从 0.1.123 起，无论哪种写法，诊断都会指出声明（期望 Mode），而不是在其中一种写法下打印它的字面量集合。
